verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no rule engine in a-Shell for triggering actions on events. The `.profile` file runs only when a new window opens, which is a fixed startup hook rather than user-defined event rules. The Apple Shortcuts integration exposes commands to Shortcuts, so any event-based automation would come from the host platform, not from a-Shell itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
